answer.action: Banks must test note sorting machines quarterly for accuracy, maintain records, phase out discontinued models by June 30, 2027, and procure only BIS certified machines.
answer.action_quote: Banks shall ensure that the Note Sorting machines are tested for accuracy and consistency on a quarterly basis and recalibrated, if required.

effective_date.quote: The previous circulars issued on the subject (Annexed) stand withdrawn from the date of issuance of this Master Direction.

comply_by.quote: NSM models deployed at banks which have been discontinued from production, shall be phased out on or before June 30, 2027.
